name: course-factory
description: Build an accredited instructor-led course as one-page HTML modules on trainee and instructor Android tablets, then publish it: the build order, the accredited-hours law in two tracks, ILO immutability, the canonical presentation framework - shell, screen-composition vocabulary and document page - what representation actually teaches a concept, the instructional-animation law, the four-level asset pipeline, trainee task screens, a verification suite that tests the RENDER and whether a screen is composed rather than merely fitting, and a publisher that separates trainee from instructor content.
